get.summary: Get the build this backend was deployed from
Hold a connection open while background work runs
get.description:
Held open for as long as there is background work, up to a bounded window.

Cloud Run may reclaim an instance that has no request in flight. Summarisation and
evaluation both run as background tasks after their response was already sent, so this
open connection is what keeps the instance carrying them alive.

Returns as soon as the work finishes, so callers loop on `active_work > 0` and an idle
caller cannot pin an instance.

MatchReferenceLength.title: MatchReferenceLength
MatchReferenceLength.description:
Evaluation-only: target_words/target_sentences are derived from a golden_summary at
resolve time, not stored here. tolerance_pct is not consumed by resolve_target_length —
it is metadata for later metrics/reporting on how far actual output drifted from the
(exactly-matched) target, not an input to generation.

PairwiseDeepevalItem.title: PairwiseDeepevalItem

SummaryResponse.title: SummaryResponse
SummaryResponse.description:
Structured output the LLM is asked to produce.

Exactly one of summary/key_takeaways is populated, matching output_format — the other
is None, not an empty placeholder, since "not generated" and "generated as empty" are
different states.
